summary: Frontend-only visual QA of the ApexOdds -> Housebets rebrand (navy + cyan). Tested at 1920x1080 and 390x844, as a guest and as admin. PASS: the tab title is 'Housebets | Crypto Sportsbook'. The header shows brand-logo-img (/brand/housebets-logo.png, 546x132) with a BETA tag. Hero says 'HOUSEBETS SPORTSBOOK'. Match cards say 'LIVE ODDS · HOUSEBETS' (the uppercase look comes from CSS). The sidebar says 'Live odds from Housebets'. Boost cards show HB and never AO. The auth modal says 'New to Housebets? Create one'. The bet slip header shows betslip-brand-logo. The slip share modal and the open-bet share modal (open-bet-brand-logo) both show the Housebets logo, with no 'apex' text. /casino/dice redirects to /. No visible 'APEX'/'Apex' text appears on home, auth modal, bet slip, share modals, wallet modal or /profile, apart from admin@apexodds.io in /admin and the affiliate code APEXVIP on /affiliate (both are data). A computed-style scan found no green accents on /profile, /admin or /affiliate. No page errors and no failed app requests; the only 404s are ESPN team logo CDN images. Found 3 small visual leftovers and 1 mobile logo bug, listed below.

ui_bugs.issue: The logo is squashed horizontally when logged in. The img is 74x28 instead of about 116x28 (natural ratio 4.14). The flex row with the wallet, admin, bell and profile buttons shrinks the image because it only has w-auto. The guest view is fine (116x28).
When the open-bet share modal is open, the cyan timeline dots of the boost cards draw on top of the dark backdrop. Their z-index is above the modal overlay.

issues: The dot next to the 'Bet Slip' title has a hardcoded green glow: shadow-[0_0_12px_rgba(52,211,153,0.8)] in BetSlip.jsx line 235. Change it to rgba(34,211,238,0.8).
The 'total' market chip uses lime colours (bg-lime-400/10 text-lime-300, BetSlip.jsx line 17), so 'Under 157.5' reads as yellow-green on the navy theme.
GameKit.jsx line 128 and Dice.jsx line 15 still use teal-400 gradients. Casino is hidden now, but these will look off if it is turned back on.
The Soccer and Tennis sport icons are green (rgb 34,197,94). These are sport identity colours, so this is probably OK.
The flash-up keyframe in index.css uses green rgba(34,197,94). This is a meaningful 'odds went up' signal, so it is acceptable.

action_items: Header.jsx: stop the mobile logo from being squashed. Add shrink-0 to the brand-logo Link or its wrapper, and/or add max-w-none or shrink-0 to the BrandLogo img.
BetSlip.jsx line 235: change the green glow rgba(52,211,153,0.8) to cyan rgba(34,211,238,0.8).
Optional: change the lime 'total' chip in BetSlip.jsx line 17 to a blue or indigo shade so the theme stays navy/cyan.
Optional: lower the z-index of the BoostsStrip leg dots, or raise the modal overlay, so they don't draw over modal backdrops.
Optional: the affiliate code APEXVIP is user data shown on /affiliate. The admin may want to change it to HOUSEBETS via Customize.
critical_code_review_comments: In index.css, @theme remaps the emerald palette to cyan. This is a quick global fix, but the class names now lie: emerald-* renders as cyan. Consider renaming them to brand-* later.

/admin logs a hydration warning about a <span> inside <option> in AdminBoosts.jsx line 47. It comes from the visual-editor instrumentation wrapping {shown.length}. Not visible to users. Using a template string in the option text (e.g. {`Choose game (${shown.length})`}) avoids it.
localStorage keys still use the apex_ prefix. They are internal and not visible, so this is fine.
seed_data_creation: None. Only logged in as admin and added two selections to the bet slip on the client side. No bets were placed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Rebrand check: log in through page.request.post(FULL_URL + '/api/auth/login'); a relative URL fails. The sign-in button testid is header-signin-button. Odds buttons are [data-testid^='odds-button-']. The mobile slip opens with bet-slip-mobile-open. The browser tool rewrites screenshot paths, so use plain filenames.
